name: Repo Astrology
description: An interactive star map that turns 29 starred GitHub repos into constellations in a night sky, with a fortune teller that generates comically overblown developer horoscopes and a personality profile with ridiculous stats. No accounts, no build step, no network calls.
author: USER

notes.status: Seeded. One static HTML page, no backend, no storage, no network. Renders a hardcoded set of 29 repos as an interactive constellation map with twinkling stars, hover tooltips, a fortune-reading oracle, and a personality profile. Pure display toy.
notes.data_streams: Deliberately empty — this app reads nothing, stores nothing, sends nothing. The constellation data and horoscope text are baked into the page.
notes.re_landing: Rebuilt against this store's manifest/catalog/CI conventions from the quick-stupids playground original (repo-astrology.html). Changes from the playground version: filename convention (index.html), test infrastructure added, constellation line rendering simplified to use hex+alpha instead of broken rgba string manipulation.
